queries.q: perfused boundary region glycocalyx longitudinal cognitive decline years before
queries.outcome: 無對位命中。回傳的 PBR 縱向研究終點為死亡率（慢性心衰二年追蹤）、心血管事件、HIV 抗病毒治療前後，無一以認知功能為終點

queries.q: glycocalyx biomarker precedes cognitive decline dementia longitudinal study years
queries.outcome: 命中 PMID:39494362（CSF bisecting GlcNAc，β=2.53±0.85 年／2.43±1.01 年）。量級相符但非糖萼標記、非 PBR、且 β 的定義不同

queries.q: "perfused boundary region" OR "sublingual glycocalyx" Alzheimer cognitive impairment blood-brain barrier
queries.outcome: 回傳綜述與腦血管糖萼的手術中量測（顳葉癲癇 PBR 2.64 vs 1.31 µm）。無縱向前導時間資料

queries.q: "glycocalyx" "2-3 years" before cognitive decline early screening window Alzheimer
queries.outcome: 精確字串未命中。再次回傳同一篇 N-醣鏈研究

queries.q: perfused boundary region correlation plasma syndecan-1 sublingual glycocalyx correlation coefficient
queries.outcome: 命中 PMID:29462714（弱相關，r=0.40）與 PMID:36523784（弱相關，PBR 與 HS/E-selectin/thrombomodulin 為中度）

queries.q: PBR GlycoCheck syndecan-1 no correlation glycocalyx shedding markers sublingual imaging discordance
queries.outcome: 命中同一份 ISICEM 增刊的敗血症摘要（n=31）：syndecan-1 與 PBR 不相關，作者自述 apparent discrepancy
